title: add incremental offline bundles and atomic upgrade/rollback flow for air-gapped installs
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds support for incremental (delta) offline bundles, cosign-signed bundle manifests, terraform outputs for airgap registries, and a new atomic upgrade CLI flag with automatic rollback support. No breaking API changes for existing offline bundles.
description:
Motivation: customers running on-prem and air-gapped private deployments requested smaller updates for constrained networks and safer upgrades with automatic rollback. This PR introduces an incremental bundle format (delta bundles) and an atomic upgrade/rollback flow for the offline installer.

Summary of changes: 1) bundle tooling: add `redwood-installer bundler delta-create` and `delta-apply` to generate/apply incremental tarballs that contain only changed OCI layers, Helm charts, and manifest patches; 2) signed metadata: bundle manifests are signed with cosign and include provenance (bundle id, parent bundle id, checksums) to enable integrity checks in disconnected environments; 3) atomic upgrade flow: installer adds `--atomic` and `--rollback-on-failure` flags (CLI and helm hooks) which perform dry-run, create a rollback bundle snapshot on success, and automatically restore last-known-good bundle on failed apply; 4) kube distro & runtime selection: installer now packages prebuilt CRI (containerd, crio) shim bits and CNI variants (calico, cilium, canal) and surfaces selection via `bundle-config.yaml`; 5) terraform and chart changes: the terraform module exports new outputs (airgap_registry, bundle_endpoint) and adds a `mirror_proxy` variable to configure an internal OCI mirror; helm templates updated to support `offlineAssets.enabled` and support imagePullSecrets templating for registry mirrors; 6) tests & CI: add an `integration/airgap` job that validates delta-creation/apply and cosign verification against a local registry mirror.

Design notes: - Delta bundles are represented as a small metadata JSON plus an OCI layer archive. The installer validates parent_id before applying to ensure correct lineage. - Cosign signatures are optional but recommended; installer supports keyless verification in offline mode with cached public keys. - Rollback is implemented by storing a snapshot bundle (tar.gz) of applied manifests and image references prior to upgrade; restore applies the snapshot and waits for readiness probes. - We attempted to avoid changing the existing full-bundle format so older installers can still apply monolithic bundles. The delta format is additive.

Files changed (high level): - cmd/redwoodctl/bundle.go (new delta subcommands, CLI flags) - internal/bundler/delta.go (delta create/apply logic, lineage checks) - internal/bundler/signing.go (cosign integration and verification helpers) - helm/redwood/templates/_helpers.tpl (offline imagePullSecret templating) - helm/redwood/values-airgap.yaml (new offlineAssets and distro selection) - terraform/modules/airgap/main.tf (mirror_proxy var and new outputs) - scripts/e2e/airgap/run-kind-mirror.sh (local mirror helper) - tests/integration/airgap/delta_apply_test.go - docs/installer/offline/bundles.md (new doc)

Upgrade/rollback plan: - Opt-in flags default off to avoid surprising existing customers. - Suggested rollout: release CLI and bundler tools, enable delta bundle creation in CI with controlled customers, then encourage mirror use and atomic upgrades. - In emergencies, operators can pass `--force-rollback` to restore last snapshot.

Security and compliance: - Bundle signatures protect against tampering in transit. - Terraform changes expose the internal mirror endpoint only as outputs gated by RBAC in the private control plane. - No secrets were left in repo; imagePullSecrets remain user-provided.

Testing and CI: The initial CI run failed on `integration/airgap` due to expired test certs; after rotating test certs and adding retry logic for registry mirror startup the job passed (see CI summary). Local e2e verified upgrades and rollbacks on k3s and kind with a private registry mirror.

Notes for reviewers: - Focus review on internal/bundler/delta.go for edge cases around partial apply and lineage mismatches. - Signing helpers are intentionally lightweight; long-term we may add a persistent key cache for stronger offline verification. - Helm changes include small templating additions; please verify backward compatibility with existing values files.

feat(cli): add --atomic and --rollback-on-failure flags to bundle apply
